mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs dampen corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong household demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 for 2 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a policy response to labor market weakness that precedes negative equity returns due to reduced corporate investment and consumer spending over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market weakness with monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%), strong housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is strong and GDPC1 growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
